artifact.title: Recent AI Infrastructure Filing Cross-Section — CoreWeave, Nebius and Astera Labs
artifact.creator: AhaSignals

researchQuestion: What can one frozen filing contract reveal across a recent AI cloud operator, a foreign-private-issuer AI cloud operator and an AI connectivity supplier?

findings: Nebius reported the fastest revenue expansion and the highest capital-spending intensity, but its cash-flow ratio is dominated by a disclosed deferred-revenue inflow and should not be read as normalized cash conversion.
CoreWeave and Nebius are closer operating-role comparators than Astera Labs; Astera is retained as a supply-chain contrast, not a business-model peer.
Astera Labs reported the strongest operating margin and lowest capital intensity in this three-issuer snapshot, consistent with a silicon supplier rather than an AI cloud capacity owner.
The Nebius diluted-share cell is Tier C because the current loss period and prior profitable period apply different dilution mechanics. It remains visible but is excluded from ranking.
limitations: This is a three-issuer descriptive filing cross-section, not a representative market sample or statistical factor test.
Issuer roles, accounting presentation and filing regimes differ. Tier labels identify those differences rather than remove them.
Company-wide results do not isolate pure AI economics, and Nebius includes adjacent businesses.
The dataset contains no market prices, valuation multiples, portfolio returns, transaction costs or execution assumptions.
